title: Stacked 64
subtitle: A 64-key case in alternating green and black sheets
role: Design, drawings for making, and the build
summary: A 64-key keyboard in a stack of alternating green and black acrylic sheets, so the layers read from the side as stripes. The Fusion file was saved 35 times between April and June 2022.

sections.heading: Stripes from the stack
sections.body: Each layer of the case is one sheet, so choosing a colour for each layer draws the side of the keyboard. Here green and black alternate. The top and bottom are black, and the green shows through wherever light gets in.

sections.heading: Built
sections.body: This one was cut and built.

sections.heading: Other pairs of colours
sections.body: The same files rendered with other sheet. These are studies, not builds.

sections.heading: Saved 35 times
sections.body: Fusion kept every save of the file. The strip shows the saves where the most changed between one version and the next.
